originality.rationale: The primary cloud-overlap and Markov product formulas are established prior work (Bergman and Rasch 2002; Lebrun et al. 2023). The assessed extension is a universal, sharp optimization over permutations of fixed cloud fractions and an exact monotone width law. No corresponding published sharp arrangement theorem was found in actual checks. Priority remains provisional due to incomplete coverage of all atmospheric and rearrangement work.
residual_risks: The sharp path-minimum rearrangement might have appeared earlier in general combinatorial or atmospheric literature under different terminology.
Real atmospheric layers need not share a uniform overlap weight or permit physical reordering.

value.rationale: A complete closed-form, attained order-uncertainty envelope for the meteorologically motivated Markov cloud-overlap model, any n and common alpha, eliminates factorial search when only unordered level fractions are retained. The growing width identifies how overlap coherence amplifies unknown-order uncertainty; a rational four-level case has an exact 5.7 percentage-point spread. This is a natural coverage quantity, not an arbitrary numeric slice, while radiative/empirical implications are explicitly limited.
